title: OpenTable
description: OpenTable's official brand guidelines (April 2025) define the primary colours Gazpacho (#EC043D), Merlot (#300610), Almond (#F3F0E8) and Salt (#FFFFFF), and the secondary colours Guava (#FF404E), Avocado (#AAC627), Kale (#7B9605), Olive (#212610), Curacao (#54D4CC), Blueberry (#07595F), Gorgonzola (#0D282E) and Pepper (#000000).
